clue.text: A red fruit produced by German chap in Cyprus

indicators.note: the German chap sits in the abbreviation for Cyprus, the island being the container here

parts.note: CY is the international abbreviation for Cyprus
Herr is the German for Mr, so a German man

explanation.surface: A red fruit grown by a German man living in Cyprus.
explanation.definitionFit: The cherry is a small stone fruit, typically red when ripe.

clue.text: An almost crabby note

indicators.note: almost tells us to stop the synonym for crabby just short of its full length, dropping its final letter

parts.note: crotchety means irritable or crabby

explanation.surface: Someone sends a rather grumpy written message.
explanation.definitionFit: In music a crotchet is a quarter note, lasting one beat in common time.

clue.text: Chilean cooked lawyer a Mexican dish

indicators.note: cooked suggests the letters of Chilean have been doctored or rearranged

parts.note: DA is a District Attorney, an American prosecuting lawyer

explanation.surface: A lawyer from Chile prepares a Mexican meal.
explanation.definitionFit: An enchilada is a rolled tortilla with a filling and chilli sauce, a staple of Mexican cooking.

clue.text: Wander about the capital, so to speak

indicators.note: so to speak signals that we want a word sounding like the capital when spoken

parts.note: Rome is the capital city of Italy

explanation.surface: Someone strolls around the capital city.
explanation.definitionFit: To roam is to wander without fixed direction.

clue.text: Apes high-ranking clergy

definitions.meaning: apes belong to the order of mammals that also includes monkeys and humans
archbishops or chief bishops of a province

explanation.surface: Senior churchmen are mocked as mimics.
explanation.definitionFit: The zoological order covers apes and monkeys, while the same word names archbishops, senior members of the clergy.

clue.text: Revolutionary fire warning

parts.note: Red is the traditional label for a communist revolutionary
to fire is to light or ignite

explanation.surface: A warning of a rebel uprising or a blaze.
explanation.definitionFit: A red signal, as at traffic lights, means stop and serves as a danger signal.

clue.text: Chief cause of outstanding season

parts.note: main means foremost or most prominent, so outstanding
spring is one of the four seasons

explanation.surface: The principal reason for an exceptional season, perhaps in sport.
explanation.definitionFit: A mainspring is the driving spring of a watch, and figuratively the principal motive or source of something.

clue.text: 500 in heavy defeat — it's all over for the royal family

indicators.note: all over here means the whole assembled piece is turned over, read from end to start
the number goes in the word for a heavy defeat

parts.note: a rout is a crushing defeat
D is the Roman numeral for 500

explanation.surface: After a crushing loss, a sports commentator declares the match finished.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' puts D inside ROUT to give ROUDT, and 'it's all over' turns that whole string backwards.
explanation.definitionFit: The Tudors were the dynasty that ruled England from Henry VII to Elizabeth I.

clue.text: Late meal is excellent including the pint

indicators.note: including means the word for excellent holds the abbreviation inside it

parts.note: super means excellent
P is a standard abbreviation for pint

explanation.surface: An evening meal is good, especially as it comes with a pint of beer.
explanation.definitionFit: Supper is an evening meal, often eaten late.

clue.text: The wood found beneath one is just right

indicators.note: in a down clue, a piece found beneath another is written after it

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral for one
deal is sawn pine or fir timber

explanation.surface: The right wood is discovered under a single tree.
explanation.definitionFit: Ideal means perfect, exactly as one would wish.

clue.text: Fruit-growing area in Oregon, cold and intractable

parts.note: OR is the postal abbreviation for the US state of Oregon
C is the abbreviation for cold, as on taps
hard means difficult to deal with or stubborn

explanation.surface: Apple growers in a cold Oregon region find the land stubborn.
explanation.definitionFit: An orchard is a piece of land planted with fruit trees.

clue.text: Became unproductive and stopped talking

definitions.meaning: like a spring or well that ceases to yield
like a speaker who suddenly forgets their lines and falls silent

explanation.surface: Someone lost both their output and their voice.
explanation.definitionFit: A source that ceases to flow is said to have dried up, and so is a performer who falls silent mid-speech.

clue.text: Steal a cot

definitions.meaning: to copy someone else's work dishonestly, as in an exam
a small bed with barred sides for a baby

explanation.surface: Someone makes off with a child's bed.
explanation.definitionFit: To crib is to plagiarise, and the same word names a baby's bed with barred sides.

clue.text: Pastry shop — for fancy pastries, that is

indicators.note: fancy here is a verb-free adjective meaning ornate, signalling the letters of pastries dressed up in a new order

parts.note: i.e. is the abbreviation of id est, Latin for that is

explanation.surface: A shop explained as the place for elaborate cakes.
explanation.definitionFit: A patisserie is a shop selling cakes and pastries, especially French ones.

clue.text: Box of assorted novelties with an extra one inside

indicators.note: inside tells us the extra piece is placed within the rearranged letters
assorted means mixed up, so the letters of novelties are rearranged

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: A gift box of mixed trinkets with one bonus item tucked in.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Box' is informal British slang for a television set.
explanation.definitionFit: Box is a colloquial name for a television set, as in watching the box.

clue.text: Having turned story over, newspaperman is delighted

indicators.note: turned, completed by over, means the word for story is flipped end to end
over completes the instruction to turn the word for story back to front

parts.note: a tale is a story
ED is short for editor, a newspaperman

explanation.surface: A journalist is thrilled after flipping a story on its head.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Having turned ... over' turns TALE into ELAT.
explanation.definitionFit: Elated means very happy, in high spirits.

clue.text: Philanthropic organisation could be uneasy about it

indicators.note: about means the word for uneasy goes around the other piece

parts.note: chary means wary or uneasy

explanation.surface: A good cause might be nervous about something.
explanation.definitionFit: A charity is a body set up to help those in need rather than make a profit.

clue.text: Increase in pace? Play for time

parts.note: tempo is speed or pace, especially in music
a rise is an increase

explanation.surface: A musician asks whether to speed up while stalling.
explanation.definitionFit: To temporise is to delay a decision in order to gain time.

clue.text: Prisoner tired? Could be feeling guilty

parts.note: con is short for convict, a prisoner
trite means stale or tired, as in an overused phrase

explanation.surface: A weary inmate may be regretting their crime.
explanation.definitionFit: Contrite means remorseful, sorry for having done wrong.

clue.text: Grandfather clock?

parts.note: the phrase looks like the longcase timepiece, but reads as a grandad who is a veteran keeping time, an aged person

explanation.surface: A tall longcase clock.
explanation.definitionFit: An elderly man, a grandfather, is a veteran of long standing, and a clock is a timer.

clue.text: Buttons beginning to pop and make lad look older

indicators.note: beginning to points at the first letter of the following word

parts.note: to age is to look older
a boy is a lad

explanation.surface: Buttons popping open, a young man tries to appear more mature.
explanation.walkthrough: Buttons is the pageboy character in the British pantomime Cinderella, and slang for a uniformed hotel page; 'Buttons' looks like fastenings, not a person.
explanation.definitionFit: A uniformed page in a hotel was nicknamed for the rows of buttons on the jacket.

clue.text: Part of that laminating job was, in retrospect, a beast

indicators.note: in retrospect means looking back, so the letters are read from right to left
part of means only some of the letters in the following word are taken

explanation.surface: Looking back, a laminating task was a brute of a job.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Part of' takes LAMINA from laminating, and 'in retrospect' turns it backwards.
explanation.definitionFit: An animal is any living creature, a beast.

clue.text: Put together from wrong edition

indicators.note: wrong signals that the letters of from are in the wrong order

explanation.surface: A book is assembled from a faulty print run.
explanation.definitionFit: Formed means shaped or constructed, made up of parts.

clue.text: Get a quick bite from bottom tom of tin in big bag

indicators.note: the bottom of tin goes in the word for a big bag

parts.note: a sack is a large bag

indicators.note: in a down clue the bottom of a word is its last letter

explanation.surface: A cat grabs a quick snack from a tin at the bottom of a big bag.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bottom' picks the last letter of tin, N, and 'in' puts it inside SACK.
explanation.definitionFit: A snack is a light meal eaten in a hurry.

clue.text: Providing clothing suitable to go with old hat

parts.note: something out is out of fashion, old hat
fitting means suitable or appropriate

explanation.surface: Advice on matching a suitable outfit to an old hat.
explanation.definitionFit: Outfitting means supplying with clothes or equipment.

clue.text: Both confused about right beat

indicators.note: about means the jumbled letters go around the other piece
confused means the letters of both are jumbled

explanation.surface: Two people are puzzled about the correct rhythm.
explanation.walkthrough: 'confused' turns BOTH into THOB, and 'about' wraps it round R.
explanation.definitionFit: A throb is a strong regular pulse or beat.

clue.text: Something to wear for pet getting old

indicators.note: getting means receiving, so the word for pet takes in the other piece

parts.note: a cat is a household pet

explanation.surface: An ageing pet needs a jacket to keep warm.
explanation.definitionFit: A coat is an outer garment worn over other clothes.

clue.text: Fixes up a bargain

indicators.note: in a down clue up means the word is written from bottom to top

parts.note: pins means fixes or fastens

explanation.surface: Someone does up a cheap find.
explanation.walkthrough: SNIP is British informal for a bargain, something cheap at the price.
explanation.definitionFit: A snip is something bought for much less than its worth.

clue.text: There's a market in Italy for this drink

parts.note: a mart is a market
I is the international vehicle registration letter for Italy

explanation.surface: Italy has a market selling this cocktail.
explanation.definitionFit: A martini is a cocktail of gin or vodka and vermouth.

clue.text: Corroborate vote against not yielding

parts.note: con is a vote or argument against, as in pros and cons
firm means unyielding or steadfast

explanation.surface: A steadfast vote against something backs up a claim.
explanation.definitionFit: To confirm is to establish the truth of, to back up with evidence.

clue.text: Call cricket side to practice area for an aperitif

parts.note: to dub is to call or name
the on side is the leg side of a cricket field
a net is a practice enclosure in cricket

explanation.surface: Summoning a cricket team to the practice nets before drinks.
explanation.walkthrough: In cricket the on side is the half of the field behind the batter's legs, and the nets are where players practise.
explanation.definitionFit: Dubonnet is a sweet fortified wine served before a meal to stimulate the appetite.

clue.text: Turn out to have a very quiet sensitivity for music

parts.note: pp is the musical marking pianissimo, very quiet
having an ear means being able to appreciate music

explanation.surface: A soft-spoken musician has a fine ear.
explanation.definitionFit: To appear is to show up or arrive, as in turning up for an event.
